title: RAG Deserves an Index: Why Ingest-Time Compilation Beats Query-Time Interpretation
abstract: arXiv:2608.20845v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Nearly every retrieval-augmented question-answering system in production ships with a hidden interpreter: on each query a language model re-derives the meaning of raw corpus text and then throws that work away. Cheaper models do not close the gap: per-token prices have fallen by orders of magnitude while inference spend has risen, because context volume grows faster than prices fall. This is the modern equivalent of the full-table scan, and the remedy is the one databases found fifty years ago: do the expensive work once, at write time, into a maintained structure that makes reads cheap. translated_title: RAG需要一个索引：为什么摄取时编译优于查询时解释
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.20845v1 公告类型：新 摘要：几乎所有生产环境中的检索增强问答系统都隐藏着一个解释器：每次查询时，语言模型都会重新推导原始语料文本的含义，然后丢弃这些工作。更便宜的模型并未缩小差距：每令牌价格已下降数个数量级，而推理支出却上升了，因为上下文量的增长速度快于价格下降的速度。这相当于现代版的全文扫描，而解决办法正是数据库在五十年前发现的：将昂贵的工作在写入时一次性完成，构建一个维护良好的结构，使读取变得廉价。一个在遇到用户之前其读取模式已知的语料库，同样可以也应该被索引。我们称这种范式为摄取时语义编译（ISC）：将语料库的含义编译成一个可查询的基底，该基底包含两个耦合层——增量维护的嵌入，以及在编译时验证其来源的原子声明——并以此为基础。
tldr: 本文提出“摄取时语义编译”（ISC）范式，主张在语料写入时构建索引（增量嵌入和验证过的原子声明），而非在查询时反复解释文本，以解决RAG系统中推理成本随上下文增长而失控的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the "ingest-time semantic compilation" (ISC) paradigm, advocating for building an index (incrementally maintained embeddings and provenance-validated atomic claims) at corpus write time rather than repeatedly interpreting text at query time, to address the uncontrolled inference costs in RAG systems as context grows.
